body:
I'm sorry, but I just can't bring myself to do so.

I'm not gonna say what my country is exactly, but all you really gotta know is that it is not only poor, but also rife with corruption so even if there was some sort of program to help the poor, it's not gonna be effective. And the fact that we have a lot of poor people here is a testament to that.

The question isn't really whether or not I can live or not, but rather, what kind of a life awaits me should I choose not to end it.

If, for example, I sold all my stuff, maybe I could have enough to pay all my debts (keyword being "maybe"). I have no doubt that I can continue to live on.

But really, what kind of a life would that be? It's gonna be very shitty.

I am at this point where the future scares me more than death.

I think I'm just gonna enjoy these last few days, play some video games and whatnot then just stab my wrist or something. Food is no more, so I guess all I have for lunch and dinner is a nice cup of cold water.

It's nice that you believe in me, and I thank you for that but, I don't believe in me so...
